**Resubmitted: deviation (WARRANTY), fallback level.**

Changes made in response to the verifier:

1. **Period phrasing repaired in operative language** — the durations now read "for a period of ninety (90) days following delivery" and "for a period of thirty (30) days following performance", curing the failed period check while keeping the same fallback-compliant terms.
2. **Subsection designation added** — the inserted paragraph now carries "(c)" in its text, so the new warranty sits and cross-references consistently alongside 9(a) and 9(b).
3. **Refund tightened** — "refund the fees paid for the non-conforming software or services", removing the ambiguity of "the amounts paid for them".

Unchanged and confirmed: minimality holds (no survival tail, no procedures, no added damages categories, no disclaimer carve-out since there is nothing to carve out of); the warranty runs from HDI to the Company; Sections 9(a) and 9(b) are untouched and uncontradicted; remedy election retained in our favour.
